query:
The national economy is an organic whole, like a machine, each part has its own function, its normal operation is determined by the components and overall performance, whether it can be fast or not will waste the machine, and blindly ask for speed will damage the machine.

Coordinated development of the national economy best supports this view.

repl_history.response:
The relevant passage in Global Context Preview states that the national economy is an organic whole "like a machine". We can infer from this analogy that coordinated development of the national economy would best support this view. In machines, coordinating the functioning parts leads to optimal performance and prevents damage.

FINAL ANSWER: Coordinated
